title: Transverse tubular normal form for constant-real-rank complex Lie algebroids
author: Dan Aguero
work: On Complex Lie Algebroids with Constant Real Rank
source_version: Official SIGMA 21 (2025) journal PDF and native TeX; acquired 2026-09-30; exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: An Euler-like real anchor section must be lifted to a complex bundle flow whose zero-time limit gives the pullback projection, and the bracket-preserving isomorphism must survive that limit. The preceding full bundle-normal-form construction is retained; the target is a transverse Lie-algebroid normal form rather than a rank-nullity or bracket-definition check.
